name: The Clubhouse
intro: You will read this week’s kids’ church page the way a family would, earn this week’s star, check it is still there after a reload, make the words bigger, and then erase the test data.

steps.do: Tap “skip the tour” (the small underlined words at the bottom right of the welcome card).
steps.see: The card changes to a last page with a big “Let’s go ›” button.
steps.tip: A green greeting strip may show at the top for a few seconds. Tap it to close it, or just wait.

steps.see: The card closes. At the top: “🏠 The Clubhouse” and “Immanuel Kids · Everything from church. Nothing from strangers.” Below it, a hello that starts “Hey Clubhouse crew! 🎉”.

steps.do: Scroll down a little and find the card labelled “THIS WEEK AT KIDS’ CHURCH”.
steps.see: It is titled “Daniel: Brave in Babylon — Week 4”, with a line underneath about what to bring this Sunday.

steps.do: Find the “⭐ VERSE OF THE WEEK” card below it.
steps.see: It shows the verse starting “Be strong and courageous…” and “— Joshua 1:9”, with a “🔊 Read it to me” button.

steps.do: Turn your sound up, then tap “🔊 Read it to me”.
steps.see: A voice reads the verse out loud, ending with “Joshua 1:9”. Nothing else on the screen changes.
steps.tip: If you hear nothing, check the silent switch on the side of your iPhone.

steps.do: Scroll to the “🕵️ CHALLENGE OF THE WEEK” card and read it.
steps.see: It is “The Secret Kindness Mission 🕵️”, with a big “I did it! ⭐” button and the words “earn a star each week — they live on your device”.
The button turns grey and now says “⭐ Done — see you Sunday!”. One ⭐ appears under it, and the line says “1 challenge done — the stars live on YOUR device”.

steps.do: Tap “⭐ Done — see you Sunday!” one more time.
steps.see: Nothing changes: still one ⭐ and still “1 challenge done”. You can only earn one star per week.

steps.do: Scroll down to the coloured countdown boxes under the challenge.
steps.see: Each box shows a big number and “days until” an event: Trunk or Treat, Shoeboxes due at church, and Christmas pageant. (Once an event’s day has passed, its box goes away.)

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: The page reloads (a short “The Clubhouse” splash may flash). Your star is still there: the button still says “⭐ Done — see you Sunday!” with one ⭐ under it.

steps.do: A card “Keep The Clubhouse on your Home Screen” has popped up near the bottom. Tap “Later” on it.
steps.see: The card goes away and you can see the page again.

steps.do: Tap the round “?” button on the right side of the screen.
steps.see: A “Help and settings” panel opens with “? Help and start fresh”, “Aa Text size — bigger or smaller” and “🎬 Take the tour again”.

steps.do: Tap “Aa Text size — bigger or smaller”.
steps.see: The panel closes and all the words on the page get bigger.

steps.do: Scroll to the very bottom and tap “🧹 Start fresh — erase this app’s data”.
steps.see: A box asks “Erase your The Clubhouse information on this phone?” and says your other Daraja apps are not touched.

steps.do: Tap OK. When a second box asks “Last check — erase this app’s data?”, tap OK again.
steps.see: The page starts over. The challenge button says “I did it! ⭐” again and the line is back to “earn a star each week — they live on your device”.
steps.tip: A “Keep The Clubhouse on your Home Screen” card may pop up. Tap “Later”.

steps.do: If the “Keep The Clubhouse on your Home Screen” card is showing, tap “Later”. Then scroll to the top.
steps.see: You are back at “🏠 The Clubhouse” with this week’s hello, exactly as a brand-new family would see it.
